_om: Engelsk översättning av klasser.json. Bara texter; siffrorna och tecknen står i den svenska filen. Klasserna kopplas ihop med sina id:n. kort är formen mitt i en mening.

klasser.beskrivning: Has fought for whoever pays for twenty years. Carries a dented shield and trusts no one.
klasser.styrka: One extra life, and strikes hardest of all and holds up well.
klasser.svaghet: Finds only half as much gold when searching.

klasser.beskrivning: Light fingers and light steps. Has got into more houses than they have walked out of.
klasser.styrka: Takes a quarter more gold from the chamber, finds items more often, and no one else notices when the serpent stirs at the Thief's hand. Snatches half the gold in fights with wanderers.
klasser.svaghet: Does not trust other people's potions: never finds any when searching.

klasser.beskrivning: Brews potions from what grows in ditches. Knows what heals and what kills.
klasser.styrka: Starts with one potion, a potion gives three lives, and poison has no hold on her.
klasser.svaghet: Loses far more treasure when the serpent wakes.

klasser.beskrivning: Has drawn maps of caves, mines and cloisters. No one has drawn the tower. Yet.
klasser.styrka: Sees through doors into the rooms next door. Sees every room anyone has found and where anyone has died. Always finds something when searching, if a secret passage can be made.
klasser.svaghet: No quick feet: when they flee a fight, the blow at their back always lands.

klasser.beskrivning: Has played for adders at markets and never been bitten. Almost never.
klasser.styrka: Sees in the chamber how many waking cards are left in the deck. The serpent does not wound them when it wakes.
klasser.svaghet: Never learned to search: finds only half as much gold when searching.

klasser.beskrivning: Reads the ground as others read books. Sees where someone has walked, and when.
klasser.styrka: Sees tracks further back and whose they are, spots half the traps in time, and sees where someone has left an item or gold, and who has taken it. Senses before others which way the signs in the wall lie.

klasser.beskrivning: Carries a lantern that has never gone out. No one knows what it burns on.
klasser.styrka: One extra life. The darkness has no hold on them, and they see creatures in the neighbouring rooms.
klasser.svaghet: The light shows: the others see them already from the neighbouring room.

klasser.beskrivning: Has walked the whole way to see the tower with their own eyes. Believes it has something to tell.
klasser.styrka: Gets clues about the tower twice as often, a potion each time the tower changes, and recognises cursed items and leaves them be.
klasser.svaghet: Never raises a weapon against other wanderers: can only defend themselves.

klasser.beskrivning: Has dug up more kings than they have seen alive. The dead never complain.
klasser.styrka: Hears where someone dies, how far away and in which direction, and gets twice as much gold where someone has died.
klasser.svaghet: Smells of death: the creatures attack them more often.

klasser.beskrivning: Went blind from a light no one else saw. Now hears what no one else hears.
klasser.styrka: Hears sounds two rooms away and whether something breathes next door, as with the bone horn, and hears how deeply the serpent sleeps wherever they are.
klasser.svaghet: Sees poorly: darkness lasts twice as long.

klasser.beskrivning: Has prayed to the serpent all their life without knowing where it lived. Now they know.
klasser.styrka: The first card that would wake the serpent becomes one that does not, the serpent does not hurt them when it wakes, and each handful gives half as much gold again.
klasser.svaghet: Takes only one handful each time they enter the chamber.

klass_val: The tower asks who you are. Choose a card before the time runs out.
klass_slump: You did not choose in time. The tower decides who you are.
klass_upptagen: Someone else chose {klass} first. Choose another card.
klass_tjuv_tyst: The serpent stirs, but you hold your breath and no one else notices.
klass_ortkvinna_gift: The mist stings your throat, but you know the herbs in it. The poison has no hold on you.
klass_kartritare_fly: You turn too slowly and stumble over your own feet.
klass_ormtjusare_kort: You count the breaths. {antal} of the cards in the deck would wake the serpent.
klass_sparfinnare_falla: You see the signs in time: {falla}. You step carefully past.
klass_lyktbarare_morker: A gust sweeps through the room, but your lantern burns on.
klass_pilgrim_fred: You do not raise a weapon against {namn}.
klass_gravplundrare_dod: You hear it clearly: {namn} dies, {antal} rooms away to the {horn}.
klass_gravplundrare_guld: You know where the dead hide the best of it, and find {antal} gold more.
klass_prast_lugnar: The serpent stirs under your hand. You whisper a prayer you have known since you were a child, and the breathing slows again.
klass_prast_en_nave: You have taken your handful. The prayer allows no more until you have gone out and come back.
klass_pilgrim_dryck: The tower changes around you. In your pocket you find a potion that was not there before.
spar_namn: Fresh footprints in the dust lead to the {riktning}. They are {namn}'s.
{namn} has walked here recently. The tracks lead to the {riktning}.
spar_ut_namn: {namn}'s footprints lead out through the gate.
